name: human-stack-mush
lane: belief-jar-1027 (from opponent-belief-1027 round 2, (h) human stack, linear features)

static.note: base[c] = w(logit p bot) lp_bot + w(logit p 17L) lp_17L + w(is land) land; pairs[s][c] (row = a shown card s) = w(PMI bot) PMI_bot + w(PMI 17L) PMI_17L (diag 0)

human.note: PMI(s, c) = log(((C_sc + lam p_c) / (n_s + lam)) / p_c), p = (n + 1) / (N + 2), diag 0; logit p = log(q / (1 - q)), q = (n + 0.5) / (N + 1)

codraft.note: max term log1p(gain * max_s cd[s][c]^2), mean term mean_s cd[s][c]; names matched exactly

manifest.note: training decks and LINEAGES: deck = sha256 of the sorted nonbasic main-deck names (front face, one per line) first 16 hex; group = sha256("mtgx-belief-group|" + token) first 16 hex, token = draft:<draft id>, pod:<pod id>, deck:<saved deck id>, game:<recorded game id> (raw ids; the host sends the same tokens)

canary.note: a synthetic entry, never a training deck: the fork test checks the lineage refusal on it
